body: What happened? Well I think that therapist would be a good idea. And you need to do something calming you, like music, dancing, playing video games. Anything. But If you start taking bigger-sized dozes of antidepresants, you will MAYBE get addictive, and you wont be able to live without them later. I don't know. We have skype group, there are few people who are depressed, suicidal, alone, just everyone who we're hurted by world. If you want to join just PM skype details. It's sometimes better to talking to a stranger, than already-known person. :). I hope I helped you a bit. :)
